summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of restored Bimbel AELC app. All 10 pytest backend tests pass (auth, CRUD for students/teachers/allocations/schedules, dashboard stats, revenue-monthly, settings, auth-protection 401). Frontend UI flow verified end-to-end: login (aelc.ask@gmail.com/AelcAdmin2026), dashboard renders stat cards + 6-month chart, Students create/list/delete via UI works (with Radix Select for program_kelas/program_bimbel), navigation across Data Guru / Siswa per Guru / Jadwal / Invoice / Pengaturan all load correctly, logout returns to login page. Auto invoice number format verified as {FirstName}-INV-AELC-{MM}-{no_urut}. Google login button present and points to auth provider (not exercised end-to-end).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: login endpoint sets cookies with SameSite=None+Secure and also returns token in body — frontend uses Bearer token via api.js which is fine; cookie path='/' set httponly on cross-origin. Working, no action.

next_invoice_no fallback: student_id path returns {FirstName}-INV-AELC-{MM}-{no_urut}; if two allocations exist for same student the invoice number will collide (no uniqueness suffix). Consider appending a counter or created_at ms suffix.
delete_student/teacher cascade removes allocations & schedules — good; but no confirmation status returned indicating counts (minor).
server.py get_current_user: for JWT branch queries by {'id': payload['sub']} but Google-session branch queries by {'user_id': ...}; ensure admin seed sets both id and user_id (it does). OK.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers in future FastAPI versions.
revenue_monthly key match uses created_at[:7] which relies on ISO string format — safe here because now_iso() always writes ISO with UTC.
Frontend Recharts warning: 'width(-1) height(-1)' — chart container briefly measured 0 while first render; cosmetic, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_ records created and cleaned up during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, all routes under /api. Auth uses Bearer JWT (7 days). App is fully functional. Google OAuth flow not exercised (requires real Google account); button present at data-testid=google-login-btn and redirects to auth.emergentagent.com. Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
